network.thermal: Optimize binary on/off commitment held constant for24h and common across scenarios. Enforce PMin/PMax conditional on commitment and source hourly ramp. Fault unit may drop at8. Initial commitment assumed already established; no startup trajectory or prehorizon minup/down qualification.
network.commitment_scope: One common fixed commitment chosen against all seven stress cases before fault identity, same for ordinary and proposed routes. Conservative restriction relative to time-varying unit commitment; not an infeasibility proof for the real grid.

acceptance.optimality: HiGHS mixed-integer primal objective, dual bound and reported MIP gap within registered fixed-commitment/common-work policy class only; independent witness feasibility is separate.

overrides.cost_evidence: All monetary coefficients uncalibrated assumptions, not vendor quotes/tariffs. Utility incremental redispatch, startup and no-load costs; tax, permitting, interconnection, backup emissions permission, curtailment compensation and jurisdiction-specific residuals are additive unknown U. Optimization is only over declared equipment-plus-operating subtotal, not complete system cost optimality.
